setup:
@known_a fact
  holds parent(person_a_0, person_b_0)
  valid timeless
  source synthetic
@known_b fact
  holds parent(person_b_0, person_c_0)
  valid timeless
  source synthetic
@grandparent_rule rule
  when parent(?x, ?y)
  when parent(?y, ?z)
  then grandparent(?x, ?z)
  mode logical
target:
@c constraint
  var ?x int 0 10
  var ?y int 0 10
  require ?x + ?y >= 3
  claim ?x >= 0
  objective 2 * ?x + ?y
  direction min
  task optimize

@result solve
  constraint $c
  output ?x one
  output ?y one

@answer cnl
  result $result
  language ro

generated.source:
@result__reason reason
  constraint $c

@x binding
  result $result__reason
  variable ?x
  mode one
  owner result

@y binding
  result $result__reason
  variable ?y
  mode one
  owner result
